health.service: AI-Powered Smart Retail & Customer Intelligence Platform

cases.response: Hello! I can help with products, orders, delivery, returns, store information, payments, and customer support.

I can help narrow a purchase by product category, features, and customer sentiment, but this demo does not connect to live inventory or prices. The reconstructed product demo covers Bottle, Mug, Headphones, and Shoe categories.
Use the order ID with the order-status service to retrieve the latest shipment state.
Standard delivery in this demo is estimated at 3–7 business days. Actual delivery depends on destination and shipping method.
Return or exchange requests should be raised through the order-support workflow with the order ID and reason for return.

Store hours are configured as 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Monday to Saturday, for this reconstructed demo. The demo retail store is configured as a generic local store; a real deployment would load the branch address from the dashboard or database.
A production version can expose the payment methods configured in the retail database. This reconstruction does not process payments.
For unresolved support cases, keep the order ID and registered contact details ready for the customer-support team.
I can help with products, order status, delivery, returns, store information, payments, and general customer support. Please rephrase your question with a little more detail.
